decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection a single storey side/rear infill conservatory extension to the existing house, as shown on drawings 06.3586.P2, 06.3586.P3 & 06.3586.P4, received 20 July 2006, would not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties and would satisfactorily maintain the street scene. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development, H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations and the Supplementary Planning Guidance.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Erection of a single storey side/rear infill conservatory extension to the existing house
